description: Backend multi-item complaint capture. A submission naming N commodities creates N Complaint rows sharing one submission_id, each fully formed. Covers: additive indexed submission_id column + idempotent startup migration; a collect-all rates resolver; a multi-item AI pipeline that NEVER raises and always returns >=1 item while keeping parse_complaint_text byte-compatible; MultiComplaintResponse schema; both POST handlers persisting N rows in one transaction and returning a primary; and backend tests. Independent of FEAT-002 (FEAT-002 depends on this response shape). Grounded in the approved design.md.
steps: Read context.json and this file FIRST. In awaaz_backend/db/models.py add `submission_id = Column(String(36), nullable=True, index=True)` immediately after the `id` column, and add `"submission_id": self.submission_id,` to the to_dict() return dict. Not a FK, not unique.

In awaaz_backend/db/session.py keep the existing create_all, then inside the same `engine.begin()` block add, guarded by `if "sqlite" in settings.DATABASE_URL:`, a call to a new helper `_ensure_submission_id_column(conn)`. That helper does `result = await conn.exec_driver_sql('PRAGMA table_info("complaints")')`, builds `cols = {row[1] for row in result.fetchall()}`, and only when `submission_id` not in cols runs `await conn.exec_driver_sql('ALTER TABLE complaints ADD COLUMN submission_id VARCHAR(36)')` then `await conn.exec_driver_sql('CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS ix_complaints_submission_id ON complaints (submission_id)')`. No new imports (settings already imported; do not use text()). Must be idempotent across fresh DB, migrated DB, and restart.

In awaaz_backend/services/rates.py add a public method `find_all_items(self, text_or_name: str) -> List[Tuple[str, Dict[str, Any]]]` that, under `self._lock`, normalises input to lowercase-stripped `norm` and iterates `self._alias_map.items()`, collecting every distinct `(canonical_id, dict(self.items[canonical_id]))` where `len(alias) >= 3 and (alias == norm or alias in norm or norm in alias)`, de-duped by canonical id via a seen-set, preserving insertion order. Tiers 1-3 only — NO fuzzy tier-4. Leave resolve_item and compare_price untouched.

In awaaz_backend/ai_pipeline.py keep whisper lazy. Rename today's single-item COMPLAINT_SCHEMA body to COMPLAINT_ITEM_SCHEMA and add COMPLAINT_SCHEMA_MULTI = {"type":"object","properties":{"items":{"type":"array","items":COMPLAINT_ITEM_SCHEMA,"minItems":1}},"required":["items"]}.

In awaaz_backend/ai_pipeline.py extend FEW_SHOT_SYSTEM_PROMPT: wrap every existing example output as {"items":[<existing output>]}, add ONE new multi-item example from the aaloo+pyaaz driver showing two items (Potato Rs 150, Onion Rs 200), and add the instruction line 'If the complaint mentions multiple commodities or multiple distinct issues, return one object per commodity/issue in items.'

In awaaz_backend/ai_pipeline.py add `_call_ollama_llm_multi(self, text) -> Optional[List[dict]]` mirroring _call_ollama_llm but passing `format=COMPLAINT_SCHEMA_MULTI`, parsing the wrapper and returning `parsed["items"]` (coerce a bare object to a one-element list), reusing the existing markdown-fence stripping and 2-attempt retry.

In awaaz_backend/ai_pipeline.py add `_segment_clauses(self, text) -> List[str]` using one re.split on the alternation of sentence punctuation (`.`, `۔`, `!`, `?`, newline) and connectives (` bhi `, ` بھی `, ` aur `, ` اور `, `،`, `,`), stripping fragments and dropping empties.

In awaaz_backend/ai_pipeline.py add `_reconcile_item(self, *, item_name_hint, reported_price_hint, category_hint, urgency_hint, native_hint, clause, text, det_lang, rule_cat, rule_urg, has_llm) -> Dict[str, Any]` by lifting the second half of today's parse_complaint_text VERBATIM, parameterised per item: resolve canonical id from item_name_hint via rate_service.resolve_item (keep raw name + canonical_id None when unresolved); price precedence `rule_price, _ = extract_price_and_normalize(clause or text)` (TUPLE unpack) then `if rule_price and rule_price > 0: price=rule_price` else float(reported_price_hint or 0) if >0 else 0.0; category: rule_cat wins for PFA/Municipal else category_hint if in valid enum else rule_cat; urgency_hint if in {Low,Medium,High} else None; `comparison = rate_service.compare_price(item_id=canonical_id or '', reported_price=price, unit=unit)`; urgency alignment for PERA against HIGH_SEVERITY/OVERCHARGE_ALERT thresholds; routing via classify_category_and_urgency(text, pct) with PFA/Municipal overrides; native_response keep native_hint when non-empty len>10 and not an English template leaking into Roman Urdu else generate_native_acknowledgment(det_lang, item_name, price_diff); needs_review/extraction_confidence identical to today (base 0.50, +0.35 when has_llm, cap for PERA with price<=0 or no canonical_id, clamp [0.20,0.99]). Return the same 15-key dict shape parse_complaint_text returns today.

In awaaz_backend/ai_pipeline.py add `_discover_items_by_rules(self, clauses) -> List[dict]`: for each clause call rate_service.find_all_items(clause); for each distinct canonical id (de-duped across clauses) build an item reconciled via _reconcile_item(has_llm=False, clause=<matching clause>, item_name_hint=name_en, ...); if NO clause yields any id, emit exactly one 'Unspecified Commodity' item (today's rule-only else-branch dict). Always returns >=1.

In awaaz_backend/ai_pipeline.py add `parse_complaint_items(self, transcript_text) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]` wrapped in a top-level try/except that logs via logger.exception and NEVER raises, always returning >=1 item. Empty/whitespace -> one-element list with the existing 'Unspecified' fallback dict. Otherwise: compute det_lang/rule_cat/rule_urg once; build LLM list from _call_ollama_llm_multi (each element through _reconcile_item(has_llm=True) with per-item clause attribution: pick the clause containing the item's resolved name/alias, else fall back to reported_price_hint); build rule list via _discover_items_by_rules; union + de-dupe by item_canonical_id (merge rule: price from rule row when >0 else LLM, recompute official/diff/percentage from chosen price via compare_price; category/urgency/native_response from LLM row when present else rule; identity fields from rule row; keep item_canonical_id==None rows only if no resolved row exists); order by percentage_overcharge desc (ties keep insertion order); guarantee >=1 element.
In awaaz_backend/ai_pipeline.py re-express parse_complaint_text as `items = self.parse_complaint_items(transcript_text); return items[0]` so existing single-item behaviour is byte-for-byte unchanged.

In awaaz_backend/schemas.py insert `submission_id: Optional[str] = None` between `id` and `created_at` on ComplaintResponse, and add `class MultiComplaintResponse(BaseModel): submission_id: str; complaints: List[ComplaintResponse]; primary: ComplaintResponse`.

In awaaz_backend/routers/complaints.py add `import uuid`; add `_select_primary(responses) -> ComplaintResponse` (max percentage_overcharge, tie-break urgency rank High=3/Medium=2/Low=1 then original order); add `async def _persist_submission(db, *, transcript_text, shared: dict) -> MultiComplaintResponse` that calls `await run_in_threadpool(ai_pipeline.parse_complaint_items, transcript_text)`, generates one `submission_id = str(uuid.uuid4())`, builds one Complaint(**per-item fields, **shared, submission_id=...) per item, db.add_all, a SINGLE await db.commit(), refresh all, validates each to ComplaintResponse, returns MultiComplaintResponse. Import MultiComplaintResponse from schemas.

In awaaz_backend/routers/complaints.py change both submit_voice_complaint and submit_text_complaint to response_model=MultiComplaintResponse (keep status 201). Each handler keeps its own `inferred_area = location_area or extract_area_from_text(...)` and passes it in shared['location_area']; voice passes audio_filename=audio.filename and audio_duration_seconds=duration_sec, text passes None/None. Voice keeps its ENTIRE existing temp-dir/FFmpeg/Whisper/400-no-speech/503-unavailable/finally-rmtree path unchanged, then calls _persist_submission. Do NOT change GET/PATCH, list filters, auth, or CORS.

In awaaz_backend/tests/test_api.py update the existing /text and /voice assertions to read the single created row via `.json()['primary']` (or complaints[0]) so prior field checks still hold; add a test POSTing the aaloo+pyaaz driver asserting len(complaints)==2, shared submission_id, distinct ids, Potato (reported 150, official 100, overcharge 50.0, PERA) and Onion (reported 200, official 120, diff 80.0, overcharge 66.7, urgency High), and primary.item_canonical_id=='pyaaz'; assert GET /api/complaints/{id} and PATCH responses include submission_id.

In awaaz_backend/tests/test_pipeline.py (keep the autouse _disable_live_llm fixture and all existing assertions green) add: a parse_complaint_items driver test (2 items with aloo 150/100/+50.0 and pyaaz 200/120/+66.7), a _segment_clauses test proving one commodity per clause for the driver, a find_all_items('aaloo aur pyaaz dono mehnge') test returning both ids, a de-dupe merge test where a rule price overrides a conflicting LLM price, and a _select_primary test returning the pyaaz row for the driver.
acceptance_criteria: `cd awaaz_backend; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import ai_pipeline, routers.complaints, db.session, schemas, services.rates"` exits 0 (whisper stays lazy).
`cd awaaz_backend; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import asyncio; from db.session import init_db; asyncio.run(init_db()); asyncio.run(init_db())"` runs twice without error (idempotent migration).

`cd awaaz_backend; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "from services.rates import rate_service; ids={i for i,_ in rate_service.find_all_items('aaloo aur pyaaz dono mehnge')}; assert {'aloo','pyaaz'} <= ids"` exits 0.
`cd awaaz_backend; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q` reports the entire suite green, including the new multi-item pipeline and API tests and all pre-existing tests.

Live: with uvicorn on port 8010, POSTing the aaloo+pyaaz driver to /api/complaints/text returns 201 with two complaints sharing one submission_id, Potato (150 vs 100, +50%) and Onion (200 vs 120, +66.7%), and primary.item_canonical_id=='pyaaz'.
verification: cd awaaz_backend; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import ai_pipeline, routers.complaints, db.session, schemas, services.rates"
cd awaaz_backend; .\venv\Scripts\python.exe -c "import asyncio; from db.session import init_db; asyncio.run(init_db()); asyncio.run(init_db())"

cd awaaz_backend; start uvicorn on port 8010, POST the aaloo+pyaaz driver to /api/complaints/text, assert the two-complaint/shared-submission_id/primary=pyaaz contract, then stop the server and clean up any scratch DB
findings:
IMPLEMENTED & VERIFIED on branch polish/final (committed locally, not pushed). All 47 backend tests green; import, double-init idempotency, and find_all_items checks pass; live POST on port 8010 (real Ollama) returned the exact 2-complaint contract.

=== RESPONSE SHAPE FOR FEAT-002 (both POST /api/complaints/text and /voice now return HTTP 201 MultiComplaintResponse) ===
MultiComplaintResponse = {
  "submission_id": "<uuid4 str>",            // shared by every row of this submission
  "complaints": [ ComplaintResponse, ... ],   // >=1, ordered by percentage_overcharge DESC (ties keep insertion order); complaints[0] == primary for the driver
  "primary": ComplaintResponse                 // highest percentage_overcharge; tie-break urgency rank High=3/Medium=2/Low=1 then original order
}
ComplaintResponse is UNCHANGED except it now carries a new optional field `submission_id: Optional[str]` (inserted between `id` and `created_at`). Every per-row field (id, item_name, item_canonical_id, unit, reported_price, official_price, price_difference_pkr, percentage_overcharge, category, urgency, status, detected_language, native_response, routing_agency, helpline_reference, location_area, shop_name, lat, lng, extraction_confidence, needs_review, admin_notes, created_at) is still populated exactly as before on EVERY row.
Shared fields copied verbatim onto all rows of a submission: transcript_raw, detected_language, location_area, shop_name, lat, lng, audio_filename, audio_duration_seconds, submission_id.
For the aaloo+pyaaz driver: complaints[0]=pyaaz (reported 200 / official 120 / diff 80 / +66.7% / High), complaints[1]=aloo (150 / 100 / +50% / High); primary.item_canonical_id=='pyaaz'.
GET /api/complaints, GET /api/complaints/{id}, PATCH /api/complaints/{id} are UNCHANGED in shape — still a single ComplaintResponse per row (now including submission_id). The list endpoint stays per-row and is NOT grouped by submission_id.
Single-item submissions return complaints length 1, primary == complaints[0]. No-item/empty submissions return exactly one 'Unspecified' fallback row with a non-null submission_id.

=== FRONTEND NOTE FOR FEAT-002 ===
lib/api.js submitTextComplaint/submitVoiceComplaint now receive the MultiComplaintResponse object (NOT a bare ComplaintResponse). A legacy single-object shape no longer comes from the backend; add normalizeComplaintResult to accept both {complaints,primary,submission_id} and a bare row for safety, and render one VerdictCard per entry in `complaints` under a 'N violations detected' header (use primary.native_response for speakText).

=== PIPELINE/BEHAVIOR NOTES ===
- ai_pipeline.parse_complaint_items(text) -> List[dict] (each dict == historical parse_complaint_text 15-key shape); never raises; always >=1 item. parse_complaint_text now returns parse_complaint_items(text)[0] (byte-compatible for single-item callers).
- services.rates.rate_service.find_all_items(text) -> List[(canonical_id, item_dict)] collects ALL tier-1..3 matches (no fuzzy); resolve_item/compare_price untouched.
- db/session.init_db adds the nullable indexed submission_id column idempotently on SQLite via PRAGMA table_info guard (safe on fresh/migrated/restart).
- DEVIATION FROM FEAT-001 step 7 worth noting: the ` bhi `/` بھی ` connective in '_segment_clauses' separates 'Pyaaz' from '200 rupay kilo', so a helper _price_clause_for() borrows the next price-only clause when a single-commodity clause has no price. This keeps the connective split (per step 7) while still attributing 200 to pyaaz (per the acceptance criteria). No behavior change for single-price clauses.
- test_pipeline.py autouse _disable_live_llm fixture was extended to also stub _call_ollama_llm_multi (same intent: force the rule path deterministically).
